top_signals.title: Hyperliquid open interest climbs to $14.3 billion as HYPE hits all-time high
top_signals.summary: On Oct. 10, 2025, Hyperliquid’s OI fell by around 56% in a single day, from $14.7 billion to just $6.5 billion.

top_signals.title: Hackers breach F5 BIG-IP APM devices to deploy Linux rootkit
top_signals.summary: A Linux rootkit targeting devices in F5 BIG-IP APM environments can intercept PHP file loading and inject a fileless web shell directly into memory, avoiding the need to write malicious code to disk. [...]
